headline: Halifax Transit's new campaign shares the stories of riders with disabilities
dek: The Transit Code Accessibility campaign also explains services like Access-A-Bus, Travel Training and Request-A-Stop.
body: Halifax Transit has launched a Transit Code Accessibility campaign. The Transit Code is its guide to passenger conduct and policies for a safe, courteous and respectful ride.

The campaign features stories from riders with accessibility needs, explains the support services available and shows how other passengers can help riders with disabilities. It was shaped by a survey and community workshop earlier this year covering buses, Access-A-Bus and ferries.

Services highlighted include Access-A-Bus, fully accessible buses and ferries, audio and visual stop announcements, ramps and kneeling buses, priority seating, the Travel Training and Request-A-Stop programs, the Personal Care Attendants Policy, and accommodation for service animals and guide dogs.
means: If you or someone you travel with needs support, halifax.ca/TransitCode lists what's available.
Halifax Transit now posts service disruptions on its new Instagram account.
